payload.title: Reader stars rank pieces and train the site's own model
payload.description:
For satire the signal is whether a piece is funny.

```gherkin
Feature: Stars

  Scenario: Stars rank the home page
    Given published pieces with different star counts in the same week
    When the home page is built
    Then the piece with more stars comes first

  Scenario: Votes train the model
    Given editors' accept and reject votes on ideas
    When enough mistakes are seen
    Then the site's model is retrained on them
```
